newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico's March open unemployment rate 4.2 pct.
newsitem.headline: Mexico's March open unemployment rate 4.2 pct.

text.p: Mexico's open, or base, unemployment rate was 4.2 percent during March, the same level as the month before and down from 6.0 percent in March 1996, the National Statistics Institute said on Thursday.
In a Reuters survey of 11 economists, the average forecast was for a rate of 4.13 percent.
INEGI defines open unemployment as members of the workforce older than 12 who have searched for work but have not worked more than one hour a week during a month.
The Rate of General Pressure, which measures those in work looking for a new job as well as open unemployment, was 7.6 percent during March compared to 7.1 percent during February.

The Rate of Partial Joblessness and Unemployment, which includes open unemployment and those who have worked less than 35 hours a week due to market conditions, rose to 9.7 percent during March versus 8.3 percent in February.
The Alternative Open Unemployment Rate, which includes open unemployment as well as those who have given up looking for work, was 5.1 percent in March compared to 5.0 percent in February.
